title: Services
seo_title: Our services: five specialisms for sickness absence • React2u
seo_description: React2u offers five specialisms under one roof: Recover, Resist, Restart, Reflex and Ready. From prevention to reintegration, with one regular case manager.

data.text: From preventing absence to reintegration and HR advice. Your case manager keeps the overview.
data.alt: Two colleagues looking at a screen together

data.heading: 5 services, under one roof
data.text: Each service is a specialism in its own right. Your case manager keeps the overview of everything.

items.label: Prevention and vitality.
items.tagline: Preventing absence starts before the sick report
items.text: We map the risks and help teams stay healthy and energised at work.

items.label: Sickness absence support.
items.text: Your regular case manager guides every absence case in line with the Gatekeeper Improvement Act (Wet verbetering poortwachter), the Dutch law that sets the steps and deadlines for employer and employee.

items.label: Reintegration and careers.
items.text: Is a return to the current job not possible? Then we look for new perspective together, inside or outside the organisation.

items.label: For the temporary staffing sector.
items.tagline: The Sickness Benefits Act without worries
items.text: For staffing agencies and self-insurers (eigenrisicodragers) under the Sickness Benefits Act (Ziektewet). We support sick temp workers, also after their contract ends.

items.label: HR and employment law.
items.text: Questions about contracts, leave or dismissal during illness? You get clear advice from people who know sickness absence.
points: Second opinion and expert opinion by UWV

strook.heading: Not sure what you need?
strook.text: In a short conversation we work out together which combination suits your organisation.

data.text: You don't need to know what a service is called. Start with your question and see which label fits.

data.text: Already have an occupational health service? Switching is less work than you think. We take over ongoing absence cases, so no deadline is missed.
